title: Lease
description: Active or historical runtime grant derived from an entitlement. Source of truth: DSL Best Practices Chapter 11.01 (Lease Object); states per Annex D.

tenantId.description: Tenant to which the lease belongs.

app.description: Licensed application/product identifier. NOTE (delta D2): 'app' vs 'appId' to be confirmed.

isvId.description: ISV identifier. NOTE (delta D3, spec-gap): optional pending spec adoption.

entitlementId.description: Source entitlement from which the lease was derived.

status.description: Canonical lifecycle status per Annex D. NOTE (delta D4): the reference implementation additionally uses a 'SHADOW' state for the pending target lease during two-phase reissue; the spec's Annex D does not yet name that state. Group decision needed on whether REISSUING covers the shadow/target lease or a distinct state is added.

licenseModality.description: Granted modality governing lifecycle and metering behaviour.

dimensions.description: Granted dimensions and limits (actual granted values, not requested).

boundIdentity.description: Verified identity summary the lease is bound to (see identity-evidence semantics, Chapter 11.06).

policy.description: Effective policy snapshot governing renewal, grace, and exhaustion.

workId.description: Optional higher-level correlation identifier for a deployment or run.

renewedAt.description: Most recent successful renewal time. NOTE (delta D7): the implementation names this 'lastRenewedAt'; spec name 'renewedAt' is authoritative.

revokeReason.description: Reason for revocation. NOTE (delta D7, spec-gap): present in the implementation; recommended for adoption into the spec for auditability.

$comment: reissueId and cutoverToken from the implementation are treated as impl-internal storage detail and intentionally omitted from the canonical lease object (delta D7).
